description: This file defines a utility enum 'GatewayDeviceAuthPayload' responsible for building device authentication payloads, normalizing metadata fields, and creating signed device dictionaries for authentication purposes within a device authorization context.

methods.name: buildV3
methods.description: Constructs a version 3 device authentication payload string by concatenating various device and metadata fields separated by '|'.

methods.name: normalizeMetadataField
methods.description: Normalizes a nullable string for metadata fields by trimming whitespace and converting ASCII uppercase letters to lowercase.

methods.name: signedDeviceDictionary
methods.description: Creates a dictionary with signed device information, including signature and public key, suitable for authentication.
